openings.claim: Self-contained printed openings with optional support/extensions may ease entry while preserving routine.
openings.discriminator: Post-pairing participation improves without shorter pairing delays.
openings.probe: Counterbalance openings; observe turn distribution and anonymous attendance-frequency/usefulness responses.
openings.uncertainty: Proficiency may moderate; adaptation and observation costs unknown.

openings.claim: Fresh personal or invented information, discovery, retelling and reversed roles may neutralize shared-history advantage; offer sentence starters.
openings.discriminator: Entry improves under unchanged pairing; persistent difficulty weakens history explanation.
openings.probe: Alternate ordinary/fresh prompts across pairs, reverse order next session; observe both initiating, collect entry/usefulness/frequency slips and preparation effort.
openings.uncertainty: Novelty competes with history explanation; comfortable subjects and affordable adaptation assumed.

openings.claim: One dated next task on current sheets available every session may resolve task currency.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task answers fall; comprehension-related blanks may persist.
openings.probe: Six sessions: separate correct/earlier/blank answers, optional print-only use, queries and coordination minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Requires advance task selection and understandable dates.

openings.claim: A reusable six-date paper menu of independent tasks, distributed on attendance, may prevent carryover and repeated planning; provide equivalent in-session starters.
openings.discriminator: Earlier answers fall without more blanks; savings include initial setup/printing.
openings.probe: Six sessions: dated answers, speaking reports, all coordination costs including first week.
openings.uncertainty: Date comprehension, level suitability and savings unproven.

decision: Probe separately; no established winner. All require free inclusive participation, no public proficiency requirement, paper access, conversational purpose, one room/75 minutes and no paid time. Evaluate original 80% speaking, 85% preparation and weekly under-90-minute targets using attendance denominators and missing counts. Synthetic evidence: 72 slips/97 attendances, untimed speech and unlinked responses limit inference; usefulness definitions, attendance causes and coordination components remain unmeasured.
